page.overview:
Who is Corrin VII?

Emperor Corrin VII was Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 1919–1935 AG) during the Era of the Princes, succeeding his father Corrin V as ruler of the Corrino Imperium.

Corrin's reign came to an end in 1935, when he was succeeded by Sidir VI. Corrin had at least one child: the later emperor Menemtahe IV.
